claims.text: Enhanced conversions for web improves the accuracy of conversion measurement by supplementing existing conversion tags with securely sent, hashed first-party conversion data from the website.

evidence.locator: Enhanced conversions for web improves the accuracy of your conversion measurement...

claims.text: It is a Google Ads feature enabled at the account or conversion action level.

evidence.locator: Enabled at account or conversion action level in Google Ads

claims.text: First-party customer data such as email addresses is hashed with SHA256 one-way hashing before being sent from the website.

evidence.locator: using SHA256 one-way hashing on first-party customer data such as email addresses

claims.text: The hashed data is matched with signed-in Google accounts to attribute campaign conversions to ad events such as clicks or views.

evidence.locator: the hashed data is matched with signed-in Google accounts to attribute campaign conversions to ad events such as clicks or views

claims.text: Turning enhanced conversions off does not affect existing conversion data.

evidence.locator: turning it off does not affect existing conversion data

claims.text: Enhanced conversions data is used for bidding and reporting in Google Ads.

Because the feature supplements existing conversion tags rather than replacing them, it is positioned as an accuracy improvement layered on top of existing conversion measurement; the evidence does not quantify any uplift, so any expected performance gain is an inference and not a documented outcome.

evidence.locator: It supplements your existing conversion tags by securely sending hashed first-party conversion data from your website.
